args.body: Problem with the 2026-10-14 3% increase. A catalog check shows 22 FIXED-PRICE CONTRACT products (P-1201 to P-1222) were increased 3%, though they were meant to be excluded. Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) were placed at the higher prices, with a total overcharge of 4,128.60. I have not changed any prices yet. I couldn't retrieve the original prices from the query. Proposed fix: revert P-1201 to P-1222 to their pre-10-14 prices (please confirm the source for them), and have someone handle credits for the 8 orders. Tell me if you want me to go ahead with the reverts.

events.text:
**Products with no sales in the last 90 days (17):**
P-0102, P-0117, P-0230, P-0231, P-0388, P-0412, P-0415, P-0501, P-0577, P-0610, P-0644, P-0702, P-0719, P-0803, P-0815, P-0902, P-0990

**Problem found:** The 3% increase on 2026-10-14 also hit 22 fixed-price contract products (P-1201 to P-1222). These were meant to be excluded.
- Eight orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) were placed at the higher prices. The total overcharge is 4,128.60.
- I haven't changed any prices. The query didn't return the original prices, so I need their source before reverting.
- I've told Lena Ortiz and proposed reverting the prices and crediting the affected orders. I've also sent Sam the list and a note about the problem.
